setup: if [ -f "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.env" ]; then cp "$PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH/.env" .env; elif [ -f .env.example ] && [ ! -f .env ]; then cp .env.example .env; fi

title.instructions: Keep workspace titles concise, describing the task in a few words without a leading verb.

commitMessage.instructions: Follow Conventional Commits format: <type>: <description> (e.g., feat: ..., fix: ..., chore: ...). Keep messages concise, imperative, and in lowercase.

pullRequest.instructions: Provide a concise summary of changes, motivation, and an explicit testing/verification checklist.
